prompt: How many years apart was the founding of Snell & Wilmer from the birth of the man who got 3rd place at the 1954 Masters golf tournament?
answer:
Snell & Wilmer was founded in **1938**, while 1954 Masters third-place finisher **William “Billy Joe” Patton** was born in **1922**.  

Thus, the founding was **16 years after his birth**.
